identity.title: Retain Feature Matching Tool View XAML Partial after concrete owner audit

origin.summary: The user requested that Partial refactoring continue in scheduled cycles and that each remaining Partial be structurally reviewed rather than mechanically deleted or split.

state.current_summary: FeatureMatchingToolWpfView.xaml.cs를 factory/composition/ViewModel/shared matching runtime/base lifetime까지 추적한 no-change 구조 감사로 확인했다. View는 XAML/composition adapter, FeatureMatchingToolViewModel은 mutable property/template policy, shared matching controller/runtime은 PropertyGrid/preview/review/event/lifetime, factory와 base는 creation/release를 소유한다. 새 독립 seam이 없어 production split은 만들지 않았으며, Debug/Release contract/build와 Feature Matching WPF smoke가 통과했다.

objective.summary: Audit the Feature Matching Tool View XAML Partial and retain it only when existing concrete owners already provide the necessary state, workflow, binding, test, and lifetime boundaries without a new split.
constraints: Work only in C:\Git\2D\Dev; do not modify C:\Git\2D\Original.
Do not add a service, interface, manager, wrapper, forwarding Partial, or ViewModel split for file length alone.
Preserve FeatureMatchingToolWpfView XAML names, Learn Feature action/topic, template status, property/preview/result facade, creation path, and DisposeView lifetime.
Keep test outputs and evidence under D:\OpenVisionLab-TestData\OpenVisionLab_Dev.
Do not commit, push, tag, release, deploy, or mutate the Original repository.

criteria.text: The proof report records current/intended owners, caller path, mutable-state writer, lifetime owner, binding/public/test contract, shortest reading order, and the reason no production split is justified.

The source contract proves that the Feature Matching View Partial has no misplaced direct persistence/dialog/algorithm coupling and that the existing ViewModel, matching controller/runtime, presenter callbacks, factory/composition, and base lifetime owners are wired.

Focused Debug/Release contracts and builds, relevant Feature Matching WPF smoke, readiness, structural audit, documentation index, issue validation, and diff checks pass; broader UI/native/hardware matrices remain explicitly unverified.

artifacts.summary: Fresh full Feature Matching shell WPF smoke screenshot on the detected single monitor.

evidence.observation: The Feature Matching View Partial is a XAML/composition adapter without direct persistence, dialog, or algorithm coupling; the ViewModel owns mutable property/template policy; shared matching controller/runtime own event, PropertyGrid, preview, result-review, preset and disposal state; factory/composition/base own creation and release. No independent state/lifetime/test seam justifies a new Partial or wrapper.

FeatureMatchingPartialBoundaryContract passed 9/9 in Debug and Release, proving retained owner wiring, XAML binding/test contracts, direct-coupling absence in the View, presenter callback routing, shared runtime/controller ownership, factory/composition creation, and base release ownership.

VisionRecipeRunnerSmoke Debug/Release builds passed with 0 warnings/errors; PipelineViewerScreenshotSmoke x64 Debug passed with 0 errors and two pre-existing MSB3270 warnings; dynamic monitor detection reported one DISPLAY2 screen at 1920x1080; a fresh smoke process window probe recorded one visible top-level window at Left=182,Top=182,Right=1782,Bottom=1082 intersecting the selected monitor; the Feature Matching WPF smoke target passed with a fresh 1600x900 PNG. OpenVisionReadinessCheck Debug/Release passed all 13 checks, RefactorAudit passed with CSharpFiles=832, XamlFiles=57, PartialDeclarations=54, ProjectCycles=0, and ShellStorageCalls=0, DocumentationIndex passed with IndexedPaths=307, PL-0038 schema/closure validation passed, and git diff --check passed. events.summary: Feature Matching Tool View is a required XAML composition boundary. Existing ViewModel, presenter callbacks, shared matching controller/runtime, factory/composition, and base lifetime owners already form the necessary seams; a mechanical split would add a wrapper or duplicate state, so the Partial is retained without production changes.
PL-0038 is resolved only after the repository readiness, structural, documentation, issue, and diff checks pass. Broader theme/DPI/input/native/hardware runtime remains outside this slice.

The Feature Matching Tool View Partial audit found no independent boundary that justified a production split; focused source/build/WPF evidence was recorded. Do not reopen without a new requirement, reproducible defect, failed criterion, or changed dependency/lifetime boundary.
